id: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince (2009)

ops.old: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, a fold of potted shrimp and a sprig of dill. Cut shortcrust into small rounds, press into a patty tin, fill with fruit mince and bake at 190C for 15 minutes. Arrange both on trays for the Slug Club party.
